cases.name: Sherri Ann Walker Scherer
cases.about:
Her husband Tony Scherer says Sherri took real pride in their home, doing most the decorating herself. She and Tony married in 1981 and had two children, Steven and Megan.  Tony described his wife as very creative, and very organized.  Sherri loved to water ski and she loved her pets, always keeping a houseful.
